title: cananga candolleana
intro: Cananga candolleana, commonly known as the Ylang-Ylang tree, is a tropical flowering plant native to the Philippines and other parts of Southeast Asia. This plant is renowned for its sweet fragrance and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering various health benefits such as reducing anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Cananga candolleana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating skin issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
